metadata.title: SSPP Instance - Secure Identity Provider (Active Directory ad.utoronto.ca)
metadata.remarks: Slim SSPP instance assessing the on-premises Active Directory forest ad.utoronto.ca as an identity provider against institutional Secure Identity assurance requirements. This Active Directory instance is federated to Microsoft Entra ID.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative identity assurance requirements from the Secure Identity Provider SSPP template.

system-characteristics.system-description: On-premises Microsoft Active Directory forest providing authoritative identity authentication services and federated assertions to Microsoft Entra ID.

props.name: identity-provider-type
props.remarks: Identity provider is an on-premises Active Directory deployment.

props.name: authentication-protocols
props.remarks: Primary authentication uses Kerberos; federated authentication occurs via ADFS and Shibboleth.

props.name: federation-role
props.remarks: Active Directory is the authoritative upstream identity source for Microsoft Entra ID via federation.

props.name: password-policy-enforcement
props.remarks: Password policies are enforced using Active Directory Group Policy and fine-grained password policies.

props.name: breached-password-protection
props.remarks: Native Active Directory does not provide built-in breached password detection; supplemental controls may exist externally.

props.name: mfa-enforcement
props.remarks: Multi-factor authentication enforcement is provided through federated services (e.g., DUO via ADFS/Shibboleth) rather than natively in Active Directory.

props.name: session-assurance-model
props.remarks: Session assurance relies on Kerberos ticket lifetimes and reauthentication intervals.

props.name: identity-risk-monitoring
props.remarks: Active Directory provides limited native identity risk detection; advanced identity protection requires external tooling.

props.name: privileged-accounts
props.remarks: Privileged identities include Domain Admins and equivalent groups operating within the forest.

props.name: identity-logging
props.remarks: Authentication and directory events are logged via domain controller security logs and directory services logs.

components.title: Secure Identity Provider - Active Directory
components.description: Assessment of Active Directory ad.utoronto.ca against institutional Secure Identity assurance patterns.

links.text: Asserts compliance with the Secure Identity composite pattern subject to documented findings.

components.remarks: Identity lifecycle provisioning and disaster recovery posture are evaluated in Identity Governance SSPPs. Federation assurance impacts downstream Entra ID identity assurance.

control-implementation.remarks: Identity assurance for Active Directory is demonstrated through authentication controls, password policy enforcement, federation trust integrity, privileged identity safeguards, and identity event logging. Gaps in breached password detection, native MFA, and identity risk monitoring are evaluated via SARs.
